title: Universal Data Cleaner, Deduplicator & Format Converter
target_pain: Developers, data analysts, and researchers wasting hours manually cleaning messy CSVs, unformatted JSONs, raw logs, or scraped text lists into structured formats.
key_features: Auto-detects input format (JSON, CSV, TSV, or Line-by-Line Text)
Advanced cleaning options: Trim whitespace, remove empty rows, and deduplicate records
Instant cross-format conversion (JSON to CSV, CSV to JSON, Text List to JSON Array)
1-click Copy to Clipboard and instant CSV/JSON file download
